cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a training simulator bay — holds her keepsake at chest height; a quiet observatory planetarium foyer with a circular bench — she offers the better half of her oversized sesame bun toward the viewer; a rooftop surf-wave practice basin under a peach evening sky — she has just climbed out after an enthusiastic practice run and laughs while carrying her lightweight training board back to the rail; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — holds a cup in both hands; a sunny ranch — standing; an outdoor pool with lounge chairs and clear blue water — sitting on the ground; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — sitting on the ground; an ice palace hall of carved crystal pillars — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a city park with benches — sketches in a sketchbook and pencil; a castle courtyard rose garden around a stone fountain — standing; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — holds a microphone close to her lips; a present-day museum gallery of Three Kingdoms relics — holds a bound bundle of bamboo slips against her chest; a vast fantasy library of towering shelves — standing
